snippet.description:
In this video, Sattwik Satyakam Devta (AIR 100, UPSC CSE 2025) explains his 3-Cycle Strategy for attempting the UPSC Prelims examination. Having cleared all six of his Prelims attempts, he shares how a structured approach can help you manage uncertainty, avoid unnecessary risks and make better decisions inside the examination hall.

Register for UPSC Prelims Decision-Making Workshop: https://shorturl.at/JH0i9

In this video, you'll learn:
- The 3-Cycle approach to attempting the UPSC Prelims paper.
- How to identify questions you are confident about.
- How to approach questions where you can eliminate options.
- When to take calculated risks and when to skip a question.
- How to manage time and avoid last-minute mistakes.
- Why mock test analysis is essential for improving accuracy.

If you are preparing for UPSC CSE 2027, this discussion will help you think more strategically about your Prelims attempt. Remember, clearing Prelims is not just about how much you know; it is also about how effectively you apply that knowledge under exam conditions.
